sql: SELECT COALESCE(name_ar,name) AS account, bank_name, ROUND(balance,2) AS balance, currency, status FROM bank_accounts ORDER BY balance DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS registered,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE first_seen >= now()-interval '24 hours') AS new_24h,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE first_seen >= now()-interval '7 days') AS new_7d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE last_seen >= now()-interval '7 days') AS active_7d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(area,'')) AS areas,
  to_char(MAX(first_seen) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS last_signup,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM online_orders WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date) AS orders_today,
  (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total),2),0) FROM online_orders WHERE status NOT IN ('cancelled','canceled') AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date) AS order_sales_today,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM online_orders WHERE status='pending') AS pending_now,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM online_orders WHERE status='delivered' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date) AS delivered_today,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM online_orders WHERE status IN ('cancelled','canceled') AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date) AS cancelled_today,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM online_orders WHERE created_at >= now()-interval '7 days') AS orders_7d,
  (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total),2),0) FROM online_orders WHERE status NOT IN ('cancelled','canceled') AND created_at >= now()-interval '7 days') AS order_sales_7d
FROM app_customers

SELECT id, order_no, COALESCE(customer_name,'') AS customer, ROUND(total,2) AS total, COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(items),0) AS items, status,
  ROUND(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now()-created_at))/60) AS minutes_ago
FROM online_orders WHERE status='pending' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(c.name_ar, p.category, 'غير مصنف') AS category, ROUND(SUM(ti.line_total),2) AS revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(ti.line_total - ti.quantity*CASE WHEN ti.unit_price>0 AND ti.unit_cost>ti.unit_price*2 THEN COALESCE(p.cost,0) ELSE COALESCE(ti.unit_cost,0) END),2) AS gross_profit,
  ROUND(100*SUM(ti.line_total - ti.quantity*CASE WHEN ti.unit_price>0 AND ti.unit_cost>ti.unit_price*2 THEN COALESCE(p.cost,0) ELSE COALESCE(ti.unit_cost,0) END)/NULLIF(SUM(ti.line_total),0),1) AS margin_pct,
  SUM(ti.quantity) AS units
FROM transaction_items ti JOIN transactions t ON t.id=ti.transaction_id
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=ti.product_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id=p.category_id
WHERE t.void_status='active' AND t.created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT COALESCE(p.category, 'بدون قسم') AS category, COUNT(*) AS total,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at IS NOT NULL) AS done,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at IS NULL) AS remaining,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at IS NOT NULL AND l.counted_qty <> l.system_qty) AS mismatched,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 0) AS done_pct
FROM shelf_count_list l JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY remaining DESC, total DESC

SELECT l.counted_by AS person, COUNT(*) AS items,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') AS today,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.counted_qty <> l.system_qty) AS mismatched,
  COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(l.system_qty - l.counted_qty, 0)), 0) AS phantom_units,
  to_char(MIN(l.done_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman', 'HH24:MI') AS first_at,
  to_char(MAX(l.done_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS last_at
FROM shelf_count_list l WHERE l.done_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY l.counted_by ORDER BY items DESC

SELECT l.product_id AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.name_ar,''), p.name) AS product, p.category,
  l.system_qty::int AS system_qty, l.counted_qty, (l.counted_qty - l.system_qty)::int AS diff,
  ROUND((l.counted_qty - l.system_qty) * COALESCE(p.cost,0), 2) AS value_diff,
  l.counted_by AS person, to_char(l.done_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS at_time
FROM shelf_count_list l JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id
WHERE l.done_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY l.done_at DESC LIMIT 150

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at IS NOT NULL) AS done,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at IS NULL) AS remaining,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS done_pct,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') AS done_today,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at IS NOT NULL AND l.counted_qty = l.system_qty) AS matched,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at IS NOT NULL AND l.counted_qty <> l.system_qty) AS mismatched,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at IS NOT NULL AND l.counted_qty = 0 AND l.system_qty > 0) AS not_found,
  COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(l.system_qty - l.counted_qty, 0)) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS phantom_units,
  COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(l.counted_qty - l.system_qty, 0)) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS extra_units,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(l.system_qty - l.counted_qty, 0) * COALESCE(p.cost,0)) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS phantom_value,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM((l.counted_qty - l.system_qty) * COALESCE(p.cost,0)) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS net_value,
  COUNT(DISTINCT l.counted_by) FILTER (WHERE l.done_at IS NOT NULL) AS people,
  to_char(MAX(l.done_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS last_at
FROM shelf_count_list l JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id

WITH tx AS (
  SELECT t.id, t.total, (t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date d, (t.via_talabat OR t.payment_method IN ('talabat','ashyai')) platform
  FROM transactions t WHERE t.void_status='active' AND t.created_at >= now() - interval '31 days'
),
cg AS (SELECT ti.transaction_id, SUM(ti.quantity*CASE WHEN ti.unit_price>0 AND ti.unit_cost>ti.unit_price*2 THEN COALESCE(p.cost,0) ELSE COALESCE(ti.unit_cost,0) END) cogs
       FROM transaction_items ti JOIN tx ON tx.id=ti.transaction_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=ti.product_id GROUP BY 1)
SELECT to_char(d,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, ROUND(SUM(total),2) AS sales, COUNT(*) AS receipts, ROUND(AVG(total),2) AS basket,
       ROUND(SUM(total-COALESCE(cogs,0)),2) AS gross_profit,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE platform) AS platform_orders, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total) FILTER (WHERE platform),0),2) AS platform_sales
FROM tx LEFT JOIN cg ON cg.transaction_id=tx.id GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

WITH tz AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date AS today),
d AS (
  SELECT (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date AS day, SUM(total) AS sales, COUNT(*) AS receipts
  FROM transactions WHERE void_status='active' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT to_char(day,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, ROUND(sales,2) AS sales, receipts, EXTRACT(isodow FROM day)::int AS dow, to_char(day,'YYYY-MM') AS mon,
  CASE WHEN day = (SELECT today FROM tz) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_today
FROM d ORDER BY day

SELECT pb.id, p.name_ar AS product, pb.expiry_date::text AS expiry_date, (pb.expiry_date - current_date) AS days_left, pb.quantity_remaining AS qty, ROUND(pb.quantity_remaining*pb.cost_per_unit,2) AS value_at_cost, pb.supplier_name
FROM product_batches pb JOIN products p ON p.id=pb.product_id
WHERE pb.status='active' AND pb.quantity_remaining>0 AND pb.expiry_date BETWEEN current_date - 7 AND current_date + 30
ORDER BY pb.expiry_date, value_at_cost DESC LIMIT 25

WITH sold60 AS (SELECT DISTINCT ti.product_id FROM transaction_items ti JOIN transactions t ON t.id=ti.transaction_id WHERE t.void_status='active' AND t.created_at >= now() - interval '60 days'),
sold14 AS (SELECT ti.product_id FROM transaction_items ti JOIN transactions t ON t.id=ti.transaction_id WHERE t.void_status='active' AND t.created_at >= now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE stock>0 AND NOT hidden) AS skus_in_stock,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(stock*cost)) FROM products WHERE stock>0 AND NOT hidden AND stock*cost <= 1000) AS inventory_value,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE stock>0 AND NOT hidden AND stock*cost > 1000) AS suspect_unit_skus,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE stock>0 AND NOT hidden AND p.id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM sold60 WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL)) AS dead_skus_60d,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(stock*cost)) FROM products p WHERE stock>0 AND NOT hidden AND stock*cost <= 1000 AND p.id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM sold60 WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL)) AS dead_value,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE stock<0) AS negative_stock_skus,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE price<cost AND stock>0 AND NOT hidden AND clearance_until IS NULL) AS below_cost_skus,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN sold14 s ON s.product_id=p.id WHERE p.stock <= 2 AND NOT p.hidden) AS low_stock_fast_movers,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_batches WHERE status='active' AND quantity_remaining>0 AND expiry_date BETWEEN current_date AND current_date + 30) AS batches_expiring_30d,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_batches WHERE status='active' AND quantity_remaining>0 AND expiry_date < current_date) AS batches_expired

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT ti.product_id, SUM(ti.quantity) q14 FROM transaction_items ti JOIN transactions t ON t.id=ti.transaction_id
  WHERE t.void_status='active' AND t.created_at >= now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT p.id, p.name_ar AS product, p.stock, sold.q14 AS sold_14d, ROUND(sold.q14/14.0,1) AS per_day, p.supplier
FROM products p JOIN sold ON sold.product_id=p.id
WHERE p.stock <= 3 AND NOT p.hidden AND sold.q14 >= 3
ORDER BY sold.q14 DESC LIMIT 25

WITH tx AS (
  SELECT id, date_trunc('month', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') mo, total, COALESCE(bank_fee,0) bank_fee
  FROM transactions WHERE void_status='active' AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') - interval '5 months'
), cogs AS (
  SELECT tx.mo, SUM(ti.quantity*CASE WHEN ti.unit_price>0 AND ti.unit_cost>ti.unit_price*2 THEN COALESCE(p.cost,0) ELSE COALESCE(ti.unit_cost,0) END) cogs
  FROM transaction_items ti JOIN tx ON tx.id=ti.transaction_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=ti.product_id GROUP BY 1
), rev AS (SELECT mo, SUM(total) revenue, SUM(bank_fee) bank_fees, COUNT(*) receipts FROM tx GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', sr.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') mo, SUM(sr.total_refund) refunds, SUM(sri.quantity*COALESCE(p.cost,0)) ret_cost
  FROM sales_returns sr JOIN sales_return_items sri ON sri.return_id=sr.id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=sri.product_id
  WHERE sr.status='completed' AND sr.created_at >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') - interval '5 months' GROUP BY 1
), ic AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') mo, SUM(total_cost) internal_use
  FROM internal_consumptions WHERE status='approved' AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') - interval '5 months' GROUP BY 1
), ex AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', expense_date) mo,
    SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE ec.name_ar IN ('رواتب','رواتب مياومة')) salaries,
    SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE ec.name_ar='مصاريف ثابتة') fixed,
    SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE ec.name_ar NOT IN ('مستلزمات','رواتب','رواتب مياومة','مصاريف ثابتة')) other_opex
  FROM expenses e JOIN expense_categories ec ON ec.id=e.category_id WHERE expense_date >= (date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') - interval '5 months')::date GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT to_char(rev.mo,'YYYY-MM') AS month, rev.receipts, ROUND(rev.revenue) AS revenue, ROUND(cogs.cogs) AS cogs,
  ROUND(rev.revenue-cogs.cogs) AS gross_profit, ROUND(100*(rev.revenue-cogs.cogs)/NULLIF(rev.revenue,0),1) AS margin_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ret.refunds-ret.ret_cost,0)) AS returns_loss, ROUND(COALESCE(ic.internal_use,0)) AS internal_use, ROUND(rev.bank_fees) AS bank_fees,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ex.salaries,0)) AS salaries, ROUND(COALESCE(ex.fixed,0)) AS fixed_costs, ROUND(COALESCE(ex.other_opex,0)) AS other_opex,
  ROUND(rev.revenue-cogs.cogs-COALESCE(ret.refunds-ret.ret_cost,0)-COALESCE(ic.internal_use,0)-rev.bank_fees-COALESCE(ex.salaries,0)-COALESCE(ex.fixed,0)-COALESCE(ex.other_opex,0)) AS net_profit
FROM rev JOIN cogs ON cogs.mo=rev.mo LEFT JOIN ret ON ret.mo=rev.mo LEFT JOIN ic ON ic.mo=rev.mo LEFT JOIN ex ON ex.mo=rev.mo ORDER BY 1

SELECT cs.id AS shift_id, cs.cashier_name, to_char(cs.shift_start AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS started, cs.status,
  ROUND(cs.opening_balance,2) AS opening_balance,
  COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(t.total) FILTER (WHERE t.payment_method='cash'),2),0) AS cash_sales,
  COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(t.total) FILTER (WHERE t.payment_method<>'cash'),2),0) AS non_cash_sales,
  COUNT(t.id) AS receipts,
  ROUND(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now()-cs.shift_start))/3600,1) AS hours_open
FROM cash_shifts cs LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.shift_id=cs.id AND t.void_status='active'
WHERE cs.status='open' GROUP BY cs.id ORDER BY cs.shift_start DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN via_talabat THEN 'talabat' WHEN payment_method LIKE 'split%' THEN 'split' ELSE payment_method END AS method,
  COUNT(*) AS receipts, ROUND(SUM(total),2) AS sales
FROM transactions WHERE void_status='active' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT to_char((created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE via_talabat OR payment_method='talabat') AS talabat_orders,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total) FILTER (WHERE via_talabat OR payment_method='talabat'),0),2) AS talabat_sales,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_method='ashyai') AS ashyai_orders,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total) FILTER (WHERE payment_method='ashyai'),0),2) AS ashyai_sales
FROM transactions WHERE void_status='active' AND created_at >= now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ti.id, COALESCE(ti.product_name_ar, ti.product_name) AS product, ti.quantity, ROUND(ti.unit_price,2) AS unit_price, ROUND(ti.line_total,2) AS line_total,
  to_char(t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman','HH24:MI:SS') AS at_time, t.receipt_no,
  CASE WHEN t.via_talabat THEN 'talabat' ELSE t.payment_method END AS method,
  COALESCE(p.emoji,'📦') AS emoji, COALESCE(c.name_ar, p.category) AS category, p.stock AS stock_now,
  CASE WHEN p.thumb LIKE 'data:image/%' THEN p.thumb END AS thumb
FROM transaction_items ti JOIN transactions t ON t.id=ti.transaction_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=ti.product_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id=p.category_id
WHERE t.void_status='active' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, ti.id DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT t.receipt_no, to_char(t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman','HH24:MI:SS') AS at_time, ROUND(t.total,2) AS total,
  CASE WHEN t.via_talabat THEN 'talabat' ELSE t.payment_method END AS method, t.cashier_name,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transaction_items ti WHERE ti.transaction_id=t.id) AS items
FROM transactions t WHERE t.void_status='active' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 15

WITH outs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.product_id) sm.product_id, sm.created_at AS ran_out_at
  FROM stock_movements sm
  WHERE sm.created_at >= now() - interval '3 days' AND sm.movement_type='SALE' AND sm.stock_before > 0 AND sm.stock_after <= 0
  ORDER BY sm.product_id, sm.created_at DESC
), sold AS (
  SELECT ti.product_id, SUM(ti.quantity) q14 FROM transaction_items ti JOIN transactions t ON t.id=ti.transaction_id
  WHERE t.void_status='active' AND t.created_at >= now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY 1
), sup AS (
  SELECT ps.product_id, s.name_ar FROM product_suppliers ps JOIN suppliers s ON s.id=ps.supplier_id
  WHERE ps.id = (SELECT id FROM product_suppliers x WHERE x.product_id=ps.product_id ORDER BY is_preferred DESC, last_purchased_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
)
SELECT p.id, p.name_ar AS product, COALESCE(c.name_ar, p.category, 'غير مصنف') AS category,
  COALESCE(sup.name_ar, NULLIF(p.supplier,''), 'بدون مورد') AS supplier,
  to_char(o.ran_out_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ran_out_at,
  ROUND(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now()-o.ran_out_at))/3600,1) AS hours_out,
  p.stock AS stock_now, COALESCE(sold.q14,0) AS sold_14d, ROUND(COALESCE(sold.q14,0)/14.0,2) AS per_day, ROUND(p.price,2) AS price,
  ROUND(COALESCE(sold.q14,0)/14.0 * EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now()-o.ran_out_at))/86400 * p.price, 2) AS est_lost_sales
  , COALESCE(p.emoji,'📦') AS emoji, CASE WHEN p.thumb LIKE 'data:image/%' THEN p.thumb END AS thumb
FROM outs o JOIN products p ON p.id=o.product_id
LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN sold ON sold.product_id=p.id LEFT JOIN sup ON sup.product_id=p.id
WHERE p.stock <= 0 AND NOT p.hidden
ORDER BY category, per_day DESC LIMIT 400

WITH tz AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date today),
tx AS (SELECT t.id, (t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date AS day, t.total, (t.via_talabat OR t.payment_method LIKE '%talabat%') AS tal FROM transactions t WHERE t.void_status='active' AND t.created_at >= now() - interval '92 days'),
cg AS (SELECT ti.transaction_id, SUM(ti.quantity*CASE WHEN ti.unit_price>0 AND ti.unit_cost>ti.unit_price*2 THEN COALESCE(p.cost,0) ELSE COALESCE(ti.unit_cost,0) END) cogs, SUM(ti.quantity) units FROM transaction_items ti JOIN tx ON tx.id=ti.transaction_id AND tx.tal LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=ti.product_id GROUP BY 1),
agg AS (SELECT tx.day, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tal) o, SUM(total) FILTER (WHERE tal) s, SUM(total - COALESCE(cg.cogs,0)) FILTER (WHERE tal) gp, SUM(cg.units) u,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT tal) r, SUM(total) FILTER (WHERE NOT tal) ss FROM tx LEFT JOIN cg ON cg.transaction_id=tx.id GROUP BY 1),
d AS (SELECT g::date AS day FROM tz, generate_series(tz.today - 89, GREATEST(tz.today, DATE '2026-11-10'), interval '1 day') g)
SELECT d.day::text AS day, COALESCE(agg.o,0) AS talabat_orders, ROUND(COALESCE(agg.s,0),2) AS talabat_sales, ROUND(agg.s/NULLIF(agg.o,0),2) AS basket,
  ROUND(COALESCE(agg.gp,0),2) AS talabat_gp, COALESCE(agg.u,0) AS talabat_units, COALESCE(agg.r,0) AS store_receipts, ROUND(COALESCE(agg.ss,0),2) AS store_sales,
  ROUND(100*agg.s/NULLIF(COALESCE(agg.s,0)+COALESCE(agg.ss,0),0),1) AS share_pct, (d.day = (SELECT today FROM tz))::int AS is_today, (d.day > (SELECT today FROM tz))::int AS is_future
FROM d LEFT JOIN agg ON agg.day=d.day ORDER BY d.day

WITH tz AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') nowl, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date today),

ev AS (
  SELECT 'sync' eid, 'visibility' kind, 'تشغيل مزامنة المخزون والظهور مع طلبات' title,
    'تفعيل المنتجات المتوفرة وإيقاف النافدة تلقائيًا كل 10 دقائق (أول دفعة ' || (SELECT SUM(items) FROM talabat_push_log WHERE kind='push' AND at < (SELECT MIN(at) FROM talabat_push_log WHERE kind='push') + interval '5 min') || ' منتجًا)' details,
    (SELECT MIN(at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman' FROM talabat_push_log WHERE kind='push') at_l, NULL::timestamp end_l,
    (SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT product_id) FROM talabat_catalog WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL AND (last_pushed->>'active')::bool) product_ids, 'done' status
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'price-' || to_char(date_trunc('hour', MIN(l.at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman'),'YYYYMMDDHH24'), 'price', 'تصحيح أسعار ' || COUNT(DISTINCT x->>'sku') || ' منتجات على طلبات',
    string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(c.title_ar, x->>'sku') || ' ← ' || (x->>'price'), ' · '),
    MIN(l.at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman', NULL, array_agg(DISTINCT c.product_id) FILTER (WHERE c.product_id IS NOT NULL), 'done'
  FROM talabat_push_log l CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(l.payload) x LEFT JOIN talabat_catalog c ON c.sku = x->>'sku'
  WHERE l.kind='price' AND l.http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299 GROUP BY (l.at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'cat-92', 'category', 'تصحيح تصنيف ' || COUNT(*) || ' منتجًا على طلبات',
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.category_ar IS DISTINCT FROM w.wrong) > 0 THEN 'ظهر التعديل على ' || COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.category_ar IS DISTINCT FROM w.wrong) || ' من ' || COUNT(*) || ' منتجًا في آخر سحب — أخبر Claude بتاريخ التنفيذ ليبدأ القياس' ELSE 'أُرسل الملف — بانتظار تنفيذ طلبات (يُكتشف تلقائيًا من السحب اليومي)' END,
    NULL::timestamp /* CAT_DATE: set to the day talabat applied it */, NULL,
    array_agg(DISTINCT c.product_id) FILTER (WHERE c.product_id IS NOT NULL),
    'pending'
  FROM (VALUES ('4HY06P','ملح المائدة'),('8935001724537','رقائق خاصة'),('4XPY23','سائل غسيل الصحون'),('6253501820484','خليط الكعك'),('40477A','ألواح الشوكولاتة'),('8690758011018','توابل كاملة'),('6253805660045','معجون الطبخ'),('8994834001314','كراكرز'),('8994834001291','رقائق خاصة'),('2P4QJP','مكسرات'),('A00626','مكسرات'),('6251048200004','رول مناديل المطبخ'),('4225ZO','مكسرات'),('8690570532067','أدوات الفرك والمنظفات'),('8994834001260','كراكرز'),('7ILD42','رقائق البطاطس'),('L771KE','نودلز منكهة'),('N0TJQU','جل الاستحمام'),('5C6S7K','جل والمنظفات'),('7ZU3VI','بطاريات'),('T9F48E','مكسرات')) w(sku, wrong) JOIN talabat_catalog c ON c.sku = w.sku
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'promo-' || md5(name_ar || start_l::text), 'promo', name_ar, concat_ws(' · ', promo_type, CASE WHEN discount_pct IS NOT NULL THEN 'خصم ' || discount_pct || '%' END, notes),
    start_l, end_l, product_ids, CASE WHEN start_l > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') THEN 'planned' ELSE 'done' END
  FROM (SELECT NULL::text name_ar, NULL::text promo_type, NULL::numeric discount_pct, NULL::timestamp start_l, NULL::timestamp end_l, NULL::text[] product_ids, NULL::text notes WHERE false) pr
),
tx AS (SELECT t.id, (t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date AS day, t.total, (t.via_talabat OR t.payment_method LIKE '%talabat%') AS tal FROM transactions t WHERE t.void_status='active' AND t.created_at >= now() - interval '200 days'),
days AS (SELECT g::date AS day FROM tz, generate_series(tz.today - 199, tz.today, interval '1 day') g),
dd AS (SELECT days.day, COUNT(tx.id) FILTER (WHERE tx.tal) o, COALESCE(SUM(tx.total) FILTER (WHERE tx.tal),0) s, COALESCE(SUM(tx.total) FILTER (WHERE NOT tx.tal),0) ss FROM days LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.day=days.day GROUP BY days.day),
e AS (SELECT ev.*, CASE WHEN at_l IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN EXTRACT(hour FROM at_l) < 8 THEN at_l::date ELSE at_l::date + 1 END a0,
   LEAST(COALESCE(end_l::date, DATE '2026-11-10'), (SELECT today FROM tz) - 1) a1, COALESCE(end_l::date, DATE '2026-11-10') w1 FROM ev),
st AS (SELECT e.eid,
   AVG(dd.o) FILTER (WHERE dd.day BETWEEN e.a0-28 AND e.a0-1) b_o, STDDEV_SAMP(dd.o) FILTER (WHERE dd.day BETWEEN e.a0-28 AND e.a0-1) b_sd,
   AVG(dd.s) FILTER (WHERE dd.day BETWEEN e.a0-28 AND e.a0-1) b_s, SUM(dd.s) FILTER (WHERE dd.day BETWEEN e.a0-28 AND e.a0-1)/NULLIF(SUM(dd.o) FILTER (WHERE dd.day BETWEEN e.a0-28 AND e.a0-1),0) b_bk,
   AVG(dd.ss) FILTER (WHERE dd.day BETWEEN e.a0-28 AND e.a0-1) b_ss,
   COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dd.day BETWEEN e.a0 AND e.a1) n_after,
   AVG(dd.o) FILTER (WHERE dd.day BETWEEN e.a0 AND e.a1) a_o, AVG(dd.s) FILTER (WHERE dd.day BETWEEN e.a0 AND e.a1) a_s,
   SUM(dd.s) FILTER (WHERE dd.day BETWEEN e.a0 AND e.a1)/NULLIF(SUM(dd.o) FILTER (WHERE dd.day BETWEEN e.a0 AND e.a1),0) a_bk,
   AVG(dd.ss) FILTER (WHERE dd.day BETWEEN e.a0 AND e.a1) a_ss
  FROM e JOIN dd ON dd.day BETWEEN e.a0-28 AND GREATEST(e.a1, e.a0-1) WHERE e.a0 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.eid),
pu AS (SELECT e.eid,
   SUM(ti.quantity) FILTER (WHERE tx.tal AND tx.day BETWEEN e.a0-28 AND e.a0-1)/28.0 pb_t,
   SUM(ti.quantity) FILTER (WHERE tx.tal AND tx.day BETWEEN e.a0 AND e.a1)/NULLIF(e.a1-e.a0+1,0) pa_t,
   SUM(ti.quantity) FILTER (WHERE NOT tx.tal AND tx.day BETWEEN e.a0-28 AND e.a0-1)/28.0 pb_s,
   SUM(ti.quantity) FILTER (WHERE NOT tx.tal AND tx.day BETWEEN e.a0 AND e.a1)/NULLIF(e.a1-e.a0+1,0) pa_s,
   COUNT(DISTINCT ti.product_id) FILTER (WHERE tx.tal AND tx.day BETWEEN e.a0 AND e.a1) sold_after_t,
   COUNT(DISTINCT ti.product_id) FILTER (WHERE tx.tal AND tx.day BETWEEN e.a0-28 AND e.a0-1) sold_before_t
  FROM e JOIN transaction_items ti ON ti.product_id = ANY(e.product_ids) JOIN tx ON tx.id=ti.transaction_id
  WHERE e.a0 IS NOT NULL AND e.product_ids IS NOT NULL AND tx.day BETWEEN e.a0-28 AND GREATEST(e.a1, e.a0-1) GROUP BY e.eid, e.a0, e.a1),
td AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (t.via_talabat OR t.payment_method LIKE '%talabat%')) o FROM transactions t, tz WHERE t.void_status='active' AND (t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date = tz.today)
SELECT e.eid, e.kind,
  CASE e.kind WHEN 'visibility' THEN 'ظهور ومخزون' WHEN 'price' THEN 'أسعار' WHEN 'category' THEN 'تصنيفات' WHEN 'promo' THEN 'عرض ترويجي' ELSE 'أخرى' END AS kind_ar,
  e.title, e.details, to_char(e.at_l,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS at_local, to_char(e.end_l,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS to_day, e.status, e.a0::text AS from_day,
  COALESCE(cardinality(e.product_ids),0) AS products, COALESCE(st.n_after,0) AS days_after, e.w1::text AS window_end, CASE WHEN e.a0 IS NOT NULL THEN e.w1 - e.a0 + 1 END AS window_days,
  ROUND(st.b_o::numeric,1) AS base_orders, ROUND(st.a_o::numeric,1) AS after_orders, ROUND(100*(st.a_o-st.b_o)/NULLIF(st.b_o,0),0) AS orders_chg_pct,
  ROUND(st.b_s::numeric,1) AS base_sales, ROUND(st.a_s::numeric,1) AS after_sales, ROUND(100*(st.a_s-st.b_s)/NULLIF(st.b_s,0),0) AS sales_chg_pct,
  ROUND(st.b_bk::numeric,2) AS base_basket, ROUND(st.a_bk::numeric,2) AS after_basket,
  ROUND(100*(st.a_ss-st.b_ss)/NULLIF(st.b_ss,0),0) AS store_chg_pct,
  ROUND(100*(st.a_s-st.b_s)/NULLIF(st.b_s,0) - 100*(st.a_ss-st.b_ss)/NULLIF(st.b_ss,0),0) AS net_pct,
  ROUND(pu.pb_t::numeric,2) AS prod_tal_base, ROUND(pu.pa_t::numeric,2) AS prod_tal_after, ROUND(100*(pu.pa_t-pu.pb_t)/NULLIF(pu.pb_t,0),0) AS prod_tal_chg_pct,
  ROUND(100*(pu.pa_s-pu.pb_s)/NULLIF(pu.pb_s,0),0) AS prod_store_chg_pct, pu.sold_before_t, pu.sold_after_t,
  (SELECT o FROM td) AS talabat_orders_today,
  CASE WHEN e.a0 IS NOT NULL AND e.a1 >= e.w1 AND e.status='done' THEN 'نهائي: ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN e.status='pending' THEN 'بانتظار التنفيذ'
       WHEN e.status='planned' THEN 'لم يبدأ بعد'
       WHEN COALESCE(st.n_after,0)=0 THEN 'بانتظار أول يوم كامل'
       WHEN st.n_after < 7 AND e.a1 < e.w1 THEN 'مبكر (' || st.n_after || ' أيام) ' || CASE WHEN st.a_o >= st.b_o THEN '↑' ELSE '↓' END
       WHEN abs(st.a_o-st.b_o) >= 2*COALESCE(NULLIF(st.b_sd,0),1)/sqrt(st.n_after) THEN 'أثر واضح ' || CASE WHEN st.a_o >= st.b_o THEN '↑' ELSE '↓' END
       WHEN abs(st.a_o-st.b_o) >= COALESCE(NULLIF(st.b_sd,0),1)/sqrt(st.n_after) THEN 'إشارة ' || CASE WHEN st.a_o >= st.b_o THEN '↑' ELSE '↓' END
       ELSE 'لا فرق واضح' END AS verdict
FROM e LEFT JOIN st ON st.eid=e.eid LEFT JOIN pu ON pu.eid=e.eid
ORDER BY e.at_l DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH s AS (SELECT ti.product_id, SUM(ti.quantity) u, SUM(ti.line_total) rev FROM transaction_items ti JOIN transactions t ON t.id=ti.transaction_id
  WHERE t.void_status='active' AND t.created_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND NOT (t.via_talabat OR t.payment_method LIKE '%talabat%') GROUP BY 1),
tc AS (SELECT product_id, bool_or(COALESCE((last_pushed->>'active')::bool, active)) act FROM talabat_catalog WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1)
SELECT p.id, p.name_ar AS product, COALESCE(c.name_ar, p.category) AS category, s.u AS units_30d, ROUND(s.rev,2) AS revenue_30d, p.stock,
  CASE WHEN tc.product_id IS NULL THEN 'غير موجود' WHEN p.stock <= 0 THEN 'موقوف — نافد' ELSE 'موقوف رغم توفره' END AS status
FROM s JOIN products p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN tc ON tc.product_id=p.id
WHERE NOT p.hidden AND COALESCE(p.category_id,0) NOT IN (13,24,15) AND NOT COALESCE(p.is_quick_misc,false) AND (tc.product_id IS NULL OR NOT tc.act)
ORDER BY s.rev DESC LIMIT 25

WITH tz AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date today),
x AS (SELECT ti.product_id, COALESCE(ti.product_name_ar, ti.product_name) nm, (t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date AS dy, ti.quantity q, ti.line_total lt
  FROM transaction_items ti JOIN transactions t ON t.id=ti.transaction_id WHERE t.void_status='active' AND (t.via_talabat OR t.payment_method LIKE '%talabat%') AND t.created_at > now() - interval '16 days')
SELECT MAX(x.nm) AS product, SUM(x.q) FILTER (WHERE x.dy BETWEEN tz.today-7 AND tz.today-1) AS units_7d, SUM(x.q) FILTER (WHERE x.dy BETWEEN tz.today-14 AND tz.today-8) AS units_prev_7d,
  ROUND(SUM(x.lt) FILTER (WHERE x.dy BETWEEN tz.today-7 AND tz.today-1),2) AS revenue_7d, MAX(p.stock) AS stock
FROM x CROSS JOIN tz LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=x.product_id
GROUP BY x.product_id HAVING SUM(x.q) FILTER (WHERE x.dy BETWEEN tz.today-7 AND tz.today-1) > 0
ORDER BY revenue_7d DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15

WITH c AS (SELECT c.sku, c.product_id, COALESCE((c.last_pushed->>'active')::bool, c.active) act FROM talabat_catalog c),
pa AS (SELECT product_id, bool_or(act) act FROM c WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1),
pos AS (SELECT p.id, p.stock FROM products p WHERE NOT p.hidden AND COALESCE(p.category_id,0) NOT IN (13,24,15)),
s30 AS (SELECT ti.product_id, SUM(ti.quantity) u FROM transaction_items ti JOIN transactions t ON t.id=ti.transaction_id WHERE t.void_status='active' AND t.created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c) AS on_talabat, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c WHERE act) AS active,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pa JOIN pos ON pos.id=pa.product_id WHERE pa.act AND pos.stock>0) AS active_in_stock,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pa JOIN pos ON pos.id=pa.product_id WHERE NOT pa.act AND pos.stock>0) AS off_in_stock,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pa JOIN pos ON pos.id=pa.product_id WHERE pa.act AND COALESCE(pos.stock,0)<=0) AS active_no_stock,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pos WHERE pos.stock>0) AS pos_in_stock,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pos WHERE pos.stock>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pa WHERE pa.product_id=pos.id)) AS in_stock_missing,
  ROUND(100.0*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pa JOIN pos ON pos.id=pa.product_id WHERE pa.act AND pos.stock>0)/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pos WHERE pos.stock>0),0),1) AS coverage_pct,
  ROUND(100.0*(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s30.u),0) FROM s30 JOIN pa ON pa.product_id=s30.product_id AND pa.act JOIN pos ON pos.id=s30.product_id)/NULLIF((SELECT SUM(s30.u) FROM s30 JOIN pos ON pos.id=s30.product_id),0),1) AS demand_coverage_pct,
  (SELECT to_char(MAX(at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM talabat_push_log WHERE kind='push' AND http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299) AS last_push,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(items),0) FROM talabat_push_log WHERE kind='push' AND at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS pushed_24h,
  (SELECT to_char(MAX(fetched_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM talabat_catalog) AS last_pull

WITH tz AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') AS nowl),
tx AS (SELECT total, (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') ts FROM transactions WHERE void_status='active' AND created_at >= now() - interval '29 days'),
hrs AS (SELECT generate_series(0,23) h),
today AS (SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM ts)::int h, SUM(total) s, COUNT(*) n FROM tx, tz WHERE ts::date=nowl::date GROUP BY 1),
yest AS (SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM ts)::int h, SUM(total) s FROM tx, tz WHERE ts::date=nowl::date-1 GROUP BY 1),
lastwk AS (SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM ts)::int h, SUM(total) s FROM tx, tz WHERE ts::date=nowl::date-7 GROUP BY 1),
avg4 AS (SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM ts)::int h, SUM(total)/28.0 s FROM tx, tz WHERE ts::date < nowl::date AND ts::date >= nowl::date-28 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT hrs.h AS hour, COALESCE(today.s,0)::numeric(10,2) AS sales_today, COALESCE(today.n,0) AS receipts_today,
  COALESCE(yest.s,0)::numeric(10,2) AS sales_yesterday, COALESCE(lastwk.s,0)::numeric(10,2) AS sales_lastweek, COALESCE(avg4.s,0)::numeric(10,2) AS avg_28d,
  CASE WHEN hrs.h <= EXTRACT(hour FROM (SELECT nowl FROM tz)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS elapsed,
  CASE WHEN hrs.h = EXTRACT(hour FROM (SELECT nowl FROM tz)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_now
FROM hrs LEFT JOIN today ON today.h=hrs.h LEFT JOIN yest ON yest.h=hrs.h LEFT JOIN lastwk ON lastwk.h=hrs.h LEFT JOIN avg4 ON avg4.h=hrs.h ORDER BY 1

WITH tz AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') AS nowl),
tx AS (
  SELECT t.id, t.total, (t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman') ts,
         (t.via_talabat OR t.payment_method IN ('talabat','ashyai')) AS platform
  FROM transactions t WHERE t.void_status='active' AND t.created_at >= now() - interval '9 days'
),
cg AS (
  SELECT ti.transaction_id, SUM(ti.quantity*CASE WHEN ti.unit_price>0 AND ti.unit_cost>ti.unit_price*2 THEN COALESCE(p.cost,0) ELSE COALESCE(ti.unit_cost,0) END) cogs
  FROM transaction_items ti JOIN tx ON tx.id=ti.transaction_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=ti.product_id GROUP BY 1
),
j AS (SELECT tx.*, cg.cogs FROM tx LEFT JOIN cg ON cg.transaction_id=tx.id),
today AS (SELECT * FROM j, tz WHERE ts::date = nowl::date),
yest AS (SELECT * FROM j, tz WHERE ts::date = nowl::date - 1 AND ts::time <= nowl::time),
lastwk AS (SELECT * FROM j, tz WHERE ts::date = nowl::date - 7 AND ts::time <= nowl::time)
SELECT
  to_char((SELECT nowl FROM tz),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS as_of,
  COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(SUM(total),2) FROM today),0) AS sales_today,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM today) AS receipts_today,
  COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(AVG(total),2) FROM today),0) AS basket_today,
  COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(SUM(total-cogs),2) FROM today),0) AS gp_today,
  COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(100*SUM(total-cogs)/NULLIF(SUM(total),0),1) FROM today),0) AS margin_today,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM today WHERE platform) AS platform_orders_today,
  COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(SUM(total),2) FROM today WHERE platform),0) AS platform_sales_today,
  COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(SUM(total),2) FROM yest),0) AS sales_yesterday_same_time,
  COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(SUM(total),2) FROM lastwk),0) AS sales_lastweek_same_time,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM yest) AS receipts_yesterday_same_time,
  (SELECT to_char(MAX(ts),'HH24:MI:SS') FROM today) AS last_sale_at,
  COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(SUM(total),2) FROM today WHERE ts >= (SELECT nowl FROM tz) - interval '60 minutes'),0) AS sales_last_hour,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM today WHERE ts >= (SELECT nowl FROM tz) - interval '60 minutes') AS receipts_last_hour,
  1000 AS daily_target

SELECT COALESCE(ti.product_name_ar, ti.product_name) AS product, SUM(ti.quantity) AS units, ROUND(SUM(ti.line_total),2) AS revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(ti.line_total - ti.quantity*CASE WHEN ti.unit_price>0 AND ti.unit_cost>ti.unit_price*2 THEN COALESCE(p.cost,0) ELSE COALESCE(ti.unit_cost,0) END),2) AS gross_profit,
  MAX(p.stock) AS stock_now
FROM transaction_items ti JOIN transactions t ON t.id=ti.transaction_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=ti.product_id
WHERE t.void_status='active' AND (t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::date
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 15

WITH cg AS (
  SELECT p.category_id, COALESCE(c.name_ar, p.category, 'غير مصنف') cat, SUM(ti.quantity*CASE WHEN ti.unit_price>0 AND ti.unit_cost>ti.unit_price*2 THEN COALESCE(p.cost,0) ELSE COALESCE(ti.unit_cost,0) END) cogs30, SUM(ti.quantity) units30
  FROM transaction_items ti JOIN transactions t ON t.id=ti.transaction_id JOIN products p ON p.id=ti.product_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id=p.category_id
  WHERE t.void_status='active' AND t.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1,2
), inv AS (
  SELECT p.category_id, COALESCE(c.name_ar, p.category, 'غير مصنف') cat, SUM(p.stock*p.cost) inv_value, COUNT(*) skus,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ti.product_id FROM transaction_items ti JOIN transactions t ON t.id=ti.transaction_id WHERE t.void_status='active' AND t.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND ti.product_id IS NOT NULL)) stagnant_skus
  FROM products p LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id=p.category_id
  WHERE p.stock > 0 AND NOT p.hidden AND p.stock*p.cost <= 1000 GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(inv.cat, cg.cat) AS category, ROUND(COALESCE(cg.cogs30,0),2) AS cogs_30d, ROUND(COALESCE(inv.inv_value,0),2) AS inventory_value,
  COALESCE(inv.skus,0) AS skus, COALESCE(inv.stagnant_skus,0) AS stagnant_skus,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(inv.inv_value,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(cg.cogs30,0)/inv.inv_value,2) END AS turns_month,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(cg.cogs30,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(30*COALESCE(inv.inv_value,0)/cg.cogs30,0) END AS days_inventory
FROM inv FULL JOIN cg ON cg.category_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM inv.category_id AND cg.cat=inv.cat
WHERE COALESCE(inv.inv_value,0) > 0 OR COALESCE(cg.cogs30,0) > 0
ORDER BY cogs_30d DESC LIMIT 20

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT ti.product_id, SUM(ti.quantity) q30, SUM(ti.quantity) FILTER (WHERE t.created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') q7
  FROM transaction_items ti JOIN transactions t ON t.id=ti.transaction_id
  WHERE t.void_status='active' AND t.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT p.id, p.name_ar AS product, COALESCE(c.name_ar, p.category) AS category, p.stock,
  COALESCE(sold.q30,0) AS units_30d, COALESCE(sold.q7,0) AS units_7d,
  ROUND(COALESCE(sold.q30,0)/30.0,2) AS per_day,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(sold.q30,0) > 0 AND p.stock > 0 THEN ROUND(p.stock/(sold.q30/30.0),1) END AS days_cover,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(sold.q30,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(sold.q30/NULLIF(GREATEST(p.stock,0)+sold.q30/2.0,0),2) END AS turns_month,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(sold.q30,0)=0 THEN 'راكد'
       WHEN p.stock <= 0 THEN 'نافد'
       WHEN p.stock/(sold.q30/30.0) <= 7 THEN 'سريع'
       WHEN p.stock/(sold.q30/30.0) <= 30 THEN 'متوسط' ELSE 'بطيء' END AS speed
FROM products p LEFT JOIN sold ON sold.product_id=p.id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id=p.category_id
WHERE NOT p.hidden AND (sold.q30 > 0 OR p.stock > 0)
ORDER BY per_day DESC, p.stock DESC LIMIT 40

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT ti.product_id, SUM(ti.quantity) q30, SUM(ti.quantity*CASE WHEN ti.unit_price>0 AND ti.unit_cost>ti.unit_price*2 THEN COALESCE(p.cost,0) ELSE COALESCE(ti.unit_cost,0) END) cogs30
  FROM transaction_items ti JOIN transactions t ON t.id=ti.transaction_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=ti.product_id
  WHERE t.void_status='active' AND t.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1
), x AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.stock, CASE WHEN p.stock>0 AND p.stock*p.cost <= 1000 THEN p.stock*p.cost ELSE 0 END inv_value, COALESCE(s.q30,0) q30, COALESCE(s.cogs30,0) cogs30,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.q30,0)=0 THEN CASE WHEN p.stock>0 THEN 'stagnant' END
         WHEN p.stock <= 0 THEN 'out'
         WHEN p.stock/(s.q30/30.0) <= 7 THEN 'fast' WHEN p.stock/(s.q30/30.0) <= 30 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'slow' END speed
  FROM products p LEFT JOIN sold s ON s.product_id=p.id WHERE NOT p.hidden
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(cogs30)) AS cogs_30d, ROUND(SUM(inv_value)) AS inventory_value,
  ROUND(SUM(cogs30)/NULLIF(SUM(inv_value),0),2) AS turns_month,
  ROUND(30*SUM(inv_value)/NULLIF(SUM(cogs30),0)) AS days_inventory,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE speed='fast') AS fast, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE speed='medium') AS medium, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE speed='slow') AS slow,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE speed='out') AS out, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE speed='stagnant') AS stagnant,
  ROUND(SUM(inv_value) FILTER (WHERE speed='stagnant')) AS stagnant_value,
  ROUND(SUM(inv_value) FILTER (WHERE speed='slow')) AS slow_value
FROM x
